name: roastgate-e2e
description: Browser tests that drive the real application against a real nginx in Docker

scripts.e2e:build: docker build -t roastgate:test ../.. && docker build -t roastgate:e2e .
scripts.e2e:up: docker rm -f roastgate-e2e && docker run -d --name roastgate-e2e -p 127.0.0.1:8199:8181 roastgate:e2e
scripts.e2e:wait: timeout 60 sh -c 'until docker logs roastgate-e2e 2>&1 | grep -q "setup token:"; do sleep 1; done'
scripts.test:fresh: pnpm e2e:up && pnpm e2e:wait && pnpm test
